neighbours.label: talk about words and ways of speaking: slang, jargon, lingo, a catchphrase, 'as X would say'
fire: Teenagers today use slang that their parents simply cannot follow.

The lawyers buried the contract in so much jargon that nobody understood it.
Surfers have their own lingo for every kind of wave.
My boss keeps repeating the catchphrase "let's circle back" in every meeting.
The word "literally" is often misused to mean "figuratively".
Sailors have a colorful vocabulary of curses and nicknames.
Like my uncle used to say, never trust a dog that doesn't bark.

predictions: Sentences that refer to words, phrases or styles of speech fire; parallel sentences about habits or objects stay quiet.
